repertoireRequirements.value: Prescreening repertoire: Minimum 30-minute pre-screen video recording. Prescreening repertoire: Must include the virtuosic etude and at least three additional pieces chosen from the audition requirements. Prescreening repertoire: A movement or movements from the classical sonata or from multi-movement Romantic or contemporary pieces may be used if the total pre-screen program is at least 30 minutes. Final audition repertoire: Prepare every required category. Final audition repertoire: A prelude and fugue from The Well-Tempered Clavier, or another Bach work that includes a fugue. Final audition repertoire: A complete sonata by Haydn, Mozart, Beethoven, or Schubert. Final audition repertoire: A major solo piano work from the Romantic era, including Rachmaninoff. Final audition repertoire: Multi-movement works must be prepared in their entirety. Final audition repertoire: All works must be performed from memory.
